entries.name: apply
entries.description: Serialize one migration plan/apply/convergence window per target. Session scope supports DDL that cannot be enclosed in one transaction; the outer lease provides multi-runner ownership and fencing.

entries.name: apply:{target_id}
entries.description: Target-scoped execution lock for the privileged migration runner. target_id must be the stable non-secret target identity from the admitted execution contract, never a raw DSN.
